verdict.rationale: Evidence describes merchant-configured, single-use Braintree tokens with 'amount and time restrictions' set by the merchant, and API tools for orders/refunds/disputes — but there is no user-facing capability to set per-agent spend caps, usage limits, or to instantly revoke an agent's payment authority. The delegated-token model is merchant/session-scoped, not a persistent per-agent authority a user can cap or revoke on demand.
